text:
zara_sales: FYI Prospect LumenBridge wants a quick POC to replace PulseAPI's summarize-stream endpoint. Procurement cares about the exact chunk envelope (they surface chunk_id and partial_score), token billing differences, and a completed security questionnaire. Can we scope an SOW + POC acceptance criteria?

kai_se: I can own the tech side. Clarifying q: do they need identical chunk IDs or just stable ordering? can you paste an example payload?

zara_sales: their sample request: ```POST /v1/summarize {"doc":"...","stream":true,"mode":"segmented"}``` chunk: ```{"evt":"part","chunk_id":"p-42","text":"...","score":0.87}```

kai_se: Redwood streams newline-delimited JSON: {"type":"partial","delta":"...","final":false}. We can add a compat flag `x-compat:pulse` that mirrors chunk_id and score into metadata. Effort: 1-2 dev days + SDK adapter. Tokenizer note: Pulse uses a different tokenizer; internal compare shows ~+12% tokens on avg.

indra_infra: infra options: EU-only via dedicated eu cluster or VPC peering + static egress IP. Peering + IPs ~3 business days after DPA. Private on-prem deploy is multi-week. We support customer-managed KMS and IP allowlists.

pat_legal: I'll fill their vendor questionnaire. We can provide SOC2 Type II report, pen test summary, subprocessor list, and sign a DPA. Default retention 30d; can negotiate for audit windows. Procurement often requests a capped billing credit during migration  consider offering a short blended rate.

ops-bot: runtime deploy v4.13.2 -> fleet-eu-west-1 succeeded :white_check_mark:

kai_se: POC acceptance criteria suggestion:
- Streaming parity: chunk_id mapping & ordering preserved for first 3 chunks across 200 test docs
- Quality: summary ROUGE-L within 2% of Pulse baseline on eval set
- Latency: median chunk <130ms in EU env
- Billing: weekly token delta report and reconciliation

kai_se: quick test curl to try streaming: ```curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Compat: pulse" -d '{"doc":"<text>","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

zara_sales: pricing ask: they're at $0.00095/token with Pulse at ~120M/month. If delta ~+12% we should propose a 90-day POC cap + optional reserved capacity. Can finance sketch a blended intro rate?

pat_legal: we'll prepare DPA + security pack. If procurement insists on EU tenancy proof, infra can spin up dedicated trial region once DPA is signed.

indra_infra: action items: open peering ticket once DPA done; reserve IPs.

kai_se: action items: build compat shim PR, run chunk-diff on sample set, draft SOW + minimal shim code snippet. I'll produce a 1-page SOW by EOD tomorrow.

zara_sales: great. blockers to surface to LumenBridge: tokenization delta, minor SDK shim required if they need exact envelope, provisioning lead time for EU peering. If they accept compat header, low risk.

kai_se: TL;DR owners: zara (sales) coordinate procurement + sample logs, kai (SE) shim + tests, indra (infra) peering, pat (legal) DPA + questionnaire. Meeting scheduled Thu 10am CET.

zara_sales: tagging @kai_se @indra_infra @pat_legal. Thanks!
